name: Economy log: Manastorm CoA loot mode tokens are logged in the delivery's own transaction
contract: Requires Manastorm.CoALootMode.Enabled = 1 (the module's CoA loot mode, off by default).

With the economy log on, a level 60 non-Wildcard leader's clear of test segment 1 (Taragaman 11520) delivers Bazaar Tokens 975001 through PrepareItemDelivery. With full bags they stay in the mail, so no character save follows: the reward row (source 4) and the tokens_earned row (source 7, other) must be written in the delivery's own transaction to exist at all before a save.

steps.label: CONTROL: the leader entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible
CONTROL: the leader left the entrance protection at the boss
Refill a slot freed by a filler item that vanished
CONTROL: the leader's bags are full
CONTROL: with full bags the clear's Bazaar Tokens stay in the mail
THE LOG: the token delivery's reward row, without a save
THE LOG: its tokens_earned row is in the same transaction, without a save
THE LOG: after a save there is still exactly one tokens_earned row
